scientific_integrity: The established edge-expectation identity is credited to Faller, Pardi and Steel. Universal curvature uniqueness, sharp two-over-n bound and the conditional-environment Jensen reversal are the assessed claim; no independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Positive edge lengths, n>=3, independent and identically distributed leaf survival conditional on a common probability. The universal statement excludes heterogeneous conditional leaf risks, non-tree histories, and environmental distributions spanning the unique inflection without further information.
title: A unique environmental-risk reversal in unrooted phylogenetic diversity
